explanation: Sort a copy of each entry to obtain its character-multiset key. Group the intact original strings under that key and return only groups with at least two entries.
timeComplexity: O(n + Σ L log(L+1)) expected time for n entries of lengths L.
spaceComplexity: O(n + Σ L) space for copied keys, grouped strings and output.
